text: Ranked enrichment library like Reactome gives lot hits mostly genes wearing different names. enrichment map makes redundancy visible: gene sets become nodes, similarity becomes edges, Louvain clustering groups ones telling thing. enrichment_map_gsea() builds igraph. takes calc_fgsea() output directly. text: Reactome hierarchy, significant hits arrive correlated clumps. enrichment map makes structure explicit: nodes gene sets, edges overlap , Louvain clustering pulls groups. enrichment_map_oae() builds igraph ORA results. Nodes coloured -log10(FDR) , GSEA version colours NES.  Enrichment map -represented pathways. Three arguments change picture, set build graph rather plot . min_sim edge threshold. Raise weak overlaps vanish, splits graph , tighter communities. data 0.1 gives 89 edges across 6 communities 0.4 gives 32 edges across 11.  min_sim 0.4. Sparser, clusters fragment. resolution Louvain knob: higher gives , smaller communities. changes colouring many labels adaptive mode shows, never edges. overlap_coefficient swaps Jaccard overlap coefficient. Worth flipping whenever library mixes different set sizes. Jaccard punishes small set nested inside large one, overlap coefficient scores 1, usually meant hierarchy like Reactome.  Overlap coefficient instead Jaccard. interactive version takes graph, keeps layout, lets hover full pathway name rather truncated label.
